headline: Google Business Profile appeals now fit on one form
dek: Google has replaced its multi-step Business Profile appeals flow with a single form, according to local SEO Ben Fisher of Steady Demand, who reported it on LinkedIn on November 24. He said a case ID came back in under 30 seconds. Google has not announced the change itself.
why: A suspended or restricted profile can stop calls and direction requests overnight, so a shorter appeal path matters most to businesses that rely on Maps. This report comes from one practitioner, and how fast Google decides appeals has not changed as far as anyone has shown.
doThis: If your profile is suspended or a review or edit was rejected, gather your proof (storefront photo, utility bill, license) in one folder now so you can file through the new form in a single sitting.
